messages.subject: Planned DMS maintenance — Saturday 17 January
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 17 January until approximately 02:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please check in any open documents before then. Email will be unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
